content.short: HyperSignals surfaces order book patterns and smart-money activity on Hyperliquid.
content.description: HyperSignals reads Hyperliquid's public order book and position data to highlight what larger traders are doing, turning the chain's transparency into a social trading feed. On a venue where positioning is visible by design, this kind of product is an inevitable consequence rather than a clever trick.
content.meta: Reads Hyperliquid's public order book to show what larger traders are actually doing.
